The sealed file's judged 11 should be 10 and open_count 8 should be 9; its move (+0.98%), performance_pct 6.09 and pot_pct 10.439 are unchanged (it was sold at the same close it is now held at). Fixed in 284f825 (call_move, performance_record) and 5c2157b (signal_scorecard); Score of record and performance_record re-run 24 Nov ~10:50 Tbilisi; that run wrote the public correction event (find_estimate, 32.9411 -> 36.48).
